dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: The teahouse has really brightened up after the boss took over and kicked the Fatui and gamblers out.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: Now, Yanshang Teahouse is worthy of the title "best teahouse in Liyue Harbor."

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: If you're looking for a place to rest there, do pay us a visit!
